prose: Bloomberg reports that after a White House lunch with AI leaders, President Trump rejected the idea of new federal AI regulations, saying the government 'automatically' has regulation through the DOJ and FBI while adding that self-regulation is very important. The remarks came alongside the voluntary accord announced the same day. (Summary based on the Techmeme headline and feed excerpt; the full article could not be retrieved.)
